summary: Three named events from the page that send this buyer looking now.

items.text: Verizon announces it is shutting down its vtext.com email-to-text gateway.
items.detail: Alerts sent to @vtext.com addresses will stop arriving, so the team needs a replacement address before the date.
items.tag: Step 3: Point your existing tools at your text address

items.text: An urgent alert email sits unread while the crew is on site.
items.detail: Email reaches a crew too slowly, so the manager looks for a way to turn the same email into a text.

items.text: A staff member replies to an alert and nobody knows where the reply went.
items.detail: They ask whether replies come back to the sender's inbox before they trust texts for alerts.
items.tag: Can employees reply to a text alert??
